identity.description: FQDN (or URI) uniquely identifying this Diameter node.

realm.description: Diameter realm this node belongs to (used for routing and authentication).

product_name.description: Free-form product name string (shown in product-name AVP).

fqdn_format.description: Use FQDN format for local hostname resolution (recommended).

use_tls.description: Enable TLS for secure Diameter connections (requires certificate files).

use_dtls.description: Enable DTLS for Diameter over UDP (less common).

tls_private_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key (PEM format, unencrypted).

ca_list.description: Path to CA certificate bundle (PEM format) for peer verification.

listeners.description: List of network interfaces to listen on (SCTP recommended, TCP fallback).

allowed_peers.description: List of peer FQDNs permitted to connect (leave empty to disable peer restrictions — not recommended).

extensions.description: List of Diameter extension modules to load.

path.description: Path to the shared library (.so) for the extension.

log_file.description: Path to log file (or leave empty to log to stdout/syslog).

log_level.description: Verbosity level: 0 (none) to 9 (debug). Recommend 7 for production.

disabled_commands.description: List of command codes to disable (e.g., 257 for Capabilities-Exchange).

originate_conn.description: Allow this node to originate connections to peers (not just listen).

cnx_retry_time.description: Initial retry timeout (seconds) for failed peer connections.

cnx_max_retry_time.description: Maximum retry timeout (seconds) after exponential backoff.

cnx_max_retrans.description: Maximum retransmissions for unacknowledged messages before failing.
